activity.notes: Kim Yu-sin was a central Silla commander in the wars of unification. He led Silla forces in the destruction of Baekje in 660 and remained a principal military and political leader through the fall of Goguryeo in 668.

sources.title: 김유신
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture describes Kim Yu-sin as a central Silla commander in the unification wars, including the 660 Baekje campaign and his senior command role in 668.
